title: The Northlander
biography:
Driven into a frenzy by tribal blood-magic, the Berserkers of the Northlands are the fiercest warriors on the battlefields, often the last ones standing when dawn comes.

Gunde's lust for violence drew him south to the Stronghold, to find new battles to fight. Barely speaking the language, but knowing a worthy challenge when he sees one, he joins the Fellowship to achieve the bloodlust he needs.
playstyle:
A furious berserker driven by an insatiable hunger for battle, Gunde rends through all enemies standing in his path.

Gunde is a Melee Fighter who excels at keeping pressure on his enemies.

Rend is Gunde’s core mechanic, allowing him to stack powerful bleed effects through repeated attacks and abilities. Enemies that die while afflicted by Rend leave behind blood-soaked feathers carrying the remnants of their suffering. Absorbing these feathers allows Gunde to carry that bleeding momentum onto his next victim.

By consuming accumulated Rend with Slaughter, Gunde can unleash devastating bursts of damage in a short window.
spiritAbility:
Increases the chance to trigger a "Spirit Refund" whenever you use an ability that applies Rend, causing 5 Blood Feathers to be created on the ground near you.

You also gain "Rising Spirit" for 10 seconds, increasing your Strength by 5%.

Each time you trigger the "Spirit Refund" you gain 1 Spirit Point toward your Spirit Ability charge.
name: Gunde

<rt.meikoability2>Can be cast during Global Cooldown</>
name: Sahril's Wrath

description:
You are protected by the divine flame of Sahril, <rt.heal>granting you a shield for up to 18 seconds that absorbs up to {SahrAegisAbsorb} damage</>.

Any damage the shield absorbs is <rt.heal>reduced by 50%</>.

When the shield expires it explodes on to enemies within a 1000 radius, dealing <rt.warning>{SahrAegisDmg}</> fire damage to them.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be cast during Global Cooldown</>
name: Sahril's Aegis

description:
Conjure the <rt.absorb>Earthbreaker</> into your hands and instantly slam it into the ground, causing the ground to erupt with natural magic in a cone in front of you, dealing <rt.warning>{EarthBrkrInitialDmg}</> nature damage to all enemies in it and <rt.effect>Stunning</> them for 3 seconds.

The area continues to rupture for <rt.bold>10 seconds</>, dealing <rt.warning>{EarthBrkrTickDmg}</> <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{EarthBrkrTickPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> to enemies in standing in it.

After 10 seconds, the area erupts a 2nd time, dealing <rt.warning>{EarthBrkrFinalDmg}</> to all enemies in it and <rt.effect>stunning</> them for 3 seconds.
name: Earthbreaker

description:
Strike target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{FatedStrkDirectDmg}</> damage to it and cleaving for <rt.warning>{FatedStrkCleaveDmg}</> damage to nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Fated Strike</> applies <rt.effect>Glorious Purpose</> to you for <rt.bold>6 seconds</>, granting you <rt.meikoability2>+{CDR} increased Cooldown Acceleration</> for the duration.

If used at range, <rt.absorb>Fated Strike</> will cause you to charge to your target.
name: Fated Strike

description:
Create an arcane anomaly <rt.bold>while channeling up to 3 seconds</>, causing you to pulse <rt.warning>{AshaTickDmg}</> <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{AshaTickPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> to all enemies in a large radius around you.

While channeling <rt.absorb>Chronoshift</> you gain <rt.meikoability2>800% increased cooldown recovery</> and are protected by a temporal barrier, causing you to take <rt.bold>50% reduced damage</>.
name: Chronoshift

description:
Conjure the forces of nature to bounce between <rt.warning>up to 4 enemies</>, dealing <rt.warning>{NatFuryDmg}</> nature damage to each one, and <rt.heal>up to 4 allies</>, healing each one for {NatFuryHeal} health.

The 1st hit from <rt.absorb>Nature's Fury</> has +100% increased <rt.warning>damage</> or <rt.heal>healing</>.

<rt.absorb>Nature's Fury</> has an additional <rt.warning>+30% Critical Strike chance</>.
name: Nature's Fury

description:
Conjure <rt.warning>3 waves</> of icicles to pelt the target area, dealing <rt.warning>{IcicleAnDirectDmg}</> frost damage to all enemies in the area with each wave.

Enemies hit by the final wave of <rt.absorb>Icicles of An'zhyrz</> are afflicted by <rt.effect>Curse of An'zhyr</> permanently, taking <rt.warning>{IcicleAnTickDmg}</> frost damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{IcicleAnTickPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>.

Enemies afflicted by <rt.effect>Curse of An'zhyr</> take <rt.warning>+200% increased direct damage</> from <rt.absorb>Icicles of An'zhyr</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be cast during Global Cooldown</>
name: Icicles of An'zhyr

description:
Deal <rt.warning>{ZeralethTickDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{ZeralethTickPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 3 seconds</> to target enemy <rt.bold>while channeling</>. You are <rt.heal>healed for 100% of the damage dealt</>.

Any amount of <rt.heal>overhealing on you</> from <rt.absorb>Zarelth's Hunger</> is projected to up to 3 allies within 3000 radius of you, <rt.heal>healing those players for the overhealing amount, evenly divided</>.
name: Zeraleth's Hunger

description:
Applies up to 60 stacks of <rt.effect>Frozen Light</> evenly divided between all players within 6000 radius for 21 seconds. Each time a player with <rt.effect>Frozen Light</> takes damage, 1 stack is consumed and the player is healed for {RepLivLightHeal}. The stack count can not exceed 20 per player.

Upon expiration, each remaining stack of  <rt.effect>Frozen Light</> causes <rt.absorb>Repository of Frozen Light's</> cooldown to be reduced by 0.3 seconds.
name: Repository of Frozen Light

description: Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> is increased by <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>42%</> / <rt.effect>60%</> / <rt.effect>80%</>.
name: Heroic Brand

description: Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> grants you <rt.warning>10% increased Main Stat</> and <rt.bold>15% Damage Reduction</> for a duration equal to <rt.effect>10%</> / <rt.effect>18%</> / <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>32%</> of your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> default cooldown.
name: Martial Initiative

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike chance</> is increased by <rt.effect>9.5%</> / <rt.effect>17%</> / <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>32%</>.

If your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> deals a <rt.warning>Critical Strike</>, its <rt.bold>Cooldown</> is reduced by <rt.effect>15%</> / <rt.effect>20%</> / <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>30%</>.
name: Brave Machinations

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> generates <rt.warning>2.5 Spirit Points</> multiplied by a value equal to your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> default cooldown, divided by 30.

Your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability's</> <rt.bold>Cooldown</> is reduced by <rt.effect>25%</> / <rt.effect>50%</> / <rt.effect>75%</> / <rt.effect>100%</> when you activate your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</>.
name: Visions of Grandeur

description:
<rt.warning>Standing still for 3 seconds</> grants you <rt.bold>Patient Soul</>, increasing your <rt.heal>Max Health</> by <rt.heal>5%</> and your <rt.warning>Expertise</> rating by <rt.effect>12</> / <rt.effect>22</> / <rt.effect>32</> / <rt.effect>42</>.

<rt.bold>Patient Soul</> <rt.bold>persists for 6 seconds</> after you start moving.
name: Patient Soul

description:
<rt.warning>Every 1 second that you stand still</>, you gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Grounded Spirit</> up to <rt.bold>10 stacks</>.

<rt.warning>Upon moving</>, all stacks of <rt.bold>Grounded Spirit</> are consumed, <rt.heal>healing you and 1 other ally with low health</> for <rt.effect>60%</> / <rt.effect>116%</> / <rt.effect>172%</> / <rt.effect>228%</> <rt.heal>Main Stat</> <rt.bold>per stack consumed</>.
name: Grounded Spirit

description: <rt.warning>When you use a</> <rt.absorb>Relic Ability</>, all <rt.bold>damage you take is reduced</> by <rt.effect>4.7%</> / <rt.effect>7.8%</> / <rt.effect>10.9%</> / <rt.effect>14%</> for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.
name: Treasure Hunter's Delight

description:
Your offensive abilities have a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to grant you <rt.effect>28</> / <rt.effect>66</> / <rt.effect>104</> / <rt.effect>142</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike</>, <rt.warning>Haste</>, <rt.warning>Expertise</> <rt.bold>or</> <rt.warning>Spirit</> rating for <rt.bold>30 seconds</>. Your highest secondary stat is always the one that gets increased.

<rt.bold>Navigator's Intuition</> can trigger <rt.bold>once every 90 seconds</>.
name: Navigator's Intuition

description:
Your <rt.warning>targeted offensive abilities</> grant you <rt.effect>4</> / <rt.effect>8</> / <rt.effect>12</> / <rt.effect>16</> <rt.warning>Haste</> rating for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>, stacking up to <rt.bold>5</> times.

The <rt.warning>Haste</> is lost if you use a targeted offensive ability on any other enemy.
name: Hunter's Focus

description:
Every <rt.bold>4 seconds</> in combat that you do not take damage, you gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</>.

The <rt.warning>next time you take any damage</> it is <rt.bold>Reduced by</> <rt.effect>2% / 3% / 4.5% / 6%</> for each stack of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</> you have and <rt.bold>1 stack is removed</>.

You can have a maximum of <rt.bold>3</> stacks of <rt.bold>Stalwart Readiness</>.
name: Stalwart Readiness

description: You gain <rt.effect>2.5%</> / <rt.effect>4.7%</> / <rt.effect>7.0%</> / <rt.effect>9.3%</> more <rt.bold>Health</> from <rt.bold>Stamina</>.
name: Heart of Stone

description:
Your <rt.warning>Spirit</> Rating is increased by <rt.effect>7</> / <rt.effect>11</> / <rt.effect>17</> / <rt.effect>23</>.

Whenever you trigger a <rt.effect>Spirit Refund</> your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> is increased by <rt.effect>1.5%</> / <rt.effect>2.6%</> / <rt.effect>3.7%</> / <rt.effect>4.8%</> for <rt.bold>4 seconds</>.
name: Willful Momentum

description:
<rt.warning>When you are healed</>, you have a <rt.bold>chance</> to gain 1 stack of <rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> up to a maximum of <rt.bold>10 stacks</>.

<rt.warning>When your health dips below 50%</> all stacks of <rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> are consumed, instantly <rt.heal>Healing</> you for an amount equal to <rt.effect>108%</> / <rt.effect>188%</> / <rt.effect>268%</> / <rt.effect>348%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</> <rt.bold>per stack</>.

<rt.bold>Latent Resurgence</> will attempt to save your life if the damage brings you below zero health.

<rt.bold>(3.3 PPM)</>
name: Latent Resurgence

description: Absorbs incoming damage.
name: Divine Mediation

description:
<rt.warning>Taking damage</> has a <rt.bold>chance</> to increase your <rt.bold>Armor</> by <rt.effect>10%</> / <rt.effect>17%</> / <rt.effect>24%</> / <rt.effect>32%</> for <rt.bold>10 seconds</>. While this is active, you deal <rt.effect>16%</> / <rt.effect>29%</> / <rt.effect>42%</> / <rt.effect>55%</> <rt.warning>Main Stat physical damage</> to enemies who deal damage to you.

<rt.bold>(1.5 PPM)</>
name: Iron Spikes

description:
Your targeted, offensive abilities have a chance to spawn a <rt.bold>Ruby Storm</> that travels forward, <rt.warning>dealing damage to all enemies it touches</> equal to <rt.effect>2.4%</> / <rt.effect>4.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.4%</> / <rt.effect>7.0%</> of your <rt.bold>Current Health</>.

<rt.bold>(1.3 PPM)</>
name: Ruby Storm

description:
Each time you <rt.warning>deal damage to an enemy</>, you have a <rt.bold>chance</> <rt.bold>(</><rt.effect>0.8 PPM</> / <rt.effect>1.30 PPM</> / <rt.effect>1.80 PPM</> / <rt.effect>2.30 PPM</><rt.bold>)</> to conjure an Emerald Spike out of the ground, <rt.bold>knocking that enemy into the air</> and dealing  <rt.warning>800% Main Stat damage</> to them.

<rt.bold>Emerald Judgement</> triggers your current rank of <rt.MeikoAbility3>First Strike (Emerald Gem Power)</>.
name: Emerald Judgement

description:
Your <rt.warning>Damage</> has a <rt.bold>chance (6.7 PPM)</> to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, dealing <rt.effect>72%</> / <rt.effect>127%</> / <rt.effect>182%</> / <rt.effect>237%</> <rt.warning>Main Stat</> damage to them.

Your <rt.heal>Heals</> have a <rt.bold>chance (6.7 PPM)</> to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, healing them for an additional <rt.effect>72%</> / <rt.effect>127%</> / <rt.effect>182%</> / <rt.effect>237%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</>.

<rt.bold>Diamond Strike</> applies an amplifying effect for <rt.bold>20 seconds</> on targets it strikes, increasing its <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> to that target by <rt.bold>40%</>, <rt.bold>stacking up to 5 times</>.

<rt.bold>Diamond Strike</> gains an additional <rt.bold>+35%</> increased <rt.warning>Damage</> and <rt.heal>Healing</> for every stack of <rt.MeikoAbility3>Harmonious Soul</> you have active <rt.MeikoAbility3>(Diamond Gem Power)</>.
name: Diamond Strike

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</> causes you to conjure a <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> near you or your selected target on activation. The Sapphire Aurastone lasts as long as the <rt.effect>Spirit of Heroism</> effect from your <rt.absorb>Spirit Ability</> is active on you.

While active, <rt.effect>3.4%</> / <rt.effect>6.3%</> / <rt.effect>9.1%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> of <rt.warning>all damage you deal is accumulated</> into the <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> and released in a <rt.warning>pulse of damage</>, evenly split between nearby enemies every <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

While active, <rt.effect>4.6%</> / <rt.effect>8.4%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> / <rt.effect>16%</> of <rt.heal>all healing you do is accumulated</> into the <rt.bold>Sapphire Aurastone</> and released in a <rt.heal>pulse of healing</>, evenly split between nearby allies every <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

Each pulse empties the accumulated <rt.warning>Damage</> or <rt.heal>Healing</> stored within it.
name: Sapphire Aurastone

description:
When you deal <rt.warning>Critical Damage to an enemy</>, you deal an additional <rt.effect>4%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>8%</> / <rt.effect>11%</> of that damage to them over <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

When you <rt.heal>Critically Heal an ally</>, they are healed for an additional <rt.effect>4%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>8%</> / <rt.effect>11%</> of that amount over <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>Amethyst Splinters</> can not critically strike.
name: Amethyst Splinters

description:
Your abilities have a chance to increase your Cooldown Recovery by 30% / 36% / 42% / 48% for 15 seconds.

(1.0 PPM)
name: Topaz Winds

description: <rt.warning>Each time an enemy deals damage to you for the first time</>, you gain <rt.bold>First Man Standing</>, <rt.bold>reducing all damage</> you take by <rt.effect>3.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.2%</> / <rt.effect>7.4%</> / <rt.effect>9.6%</> for <rt.bold>20 seconds</>.
name: First Man Standing

description:
Your damage effects apply a Damage over Time to the target, dealing fire damage equal to 66% / 79% / 92% / 106% of your primary stat every 1.5 seconds over 9 seconds.

Your healing effects apply a Heal over Time to the target, healing them for 66% / 79% / 92% / 106% of your primary stat every 1.5 seconds over 9 seconds.

(1.5 PPM)
name: Kindling

description: You take <rt.effect>3%</> / <rt.effect>6%</> / <rt.effect>9%</> / <rt.effect>12%</> <rt.bold>Reduced Damage</> while you are above <rt.bold>80% health</>.
name: King of the Hill

description:
Your <rt.warning>critical strikes</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to increase your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> by <rt.effect>3.0%</> / <rt.effect>5.1%</> / <rt.effect>7.2%</> / <rt.effect>9.3%</> for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.warning>If you are below 50% health</> when <rt.bold>Vengeful Soul</> triggers, you are also <rt.heal>healed</> for an amount equal to <rt.effect>370%</> / <rt.effect>630%</> / <rt.effect>890%</> / <rt.effect>1150%</> of your <rt.heal>Main Stat</> over <rt.bold>6 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>(3.0 PPM)</>
name: Vengeful Soul

description:
<rt.warning>Every 20 Critical Strikes</> you gain <rt.effect>21</> / <rt.effect>39</> / <rt.effect>57</> / <rt.effect>75</> <rt.warning>Critical Strike</> rating for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

You can not gain stacks while <rt.bold>Seized Opportunity</> is active on you.
name: Seized Opportunity

description: Upon using your Weapon Ability, you gain 10% Cooldown Acceleration for a duration equal to 10% / 12% / 14% / 16% of your Weapon Ability's default cooldown duration.
name: Inspired Arms

description:
Your <rt.warning>abilities</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to reduce the <rt.bold>Cooldown</> of your <rt.absorb>Weapon Ability</> by <rt.effect>1.5</> / <rt.effect>4</> / <rt.effect>6</> / <rt.effect>8</> seconds and grant you and <rt.effect>1</> / <rt.effect>2</> / <rt.effect>3</> / <rt.effect>3</> allies <rt.effect>6</> / <rt.effect>10</> / <rt.effect>13</> / <rt.effect>17</> <rt.warning>Haste</> rating for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>.

<rt.bold>(1.2 PPM)</>
name: Inspired Allegiance

description:
Your <rt.warning>abilities</> have a <rt.bold>chance</> to grant you 1 stack of <rt.bold>Hidden Power</> for <rt.bold>60 seconds</>. When you have <rt.bold>5 stacks</>, <rt.warning>Hidden Power is consumed</> and <rt.bold>Power Revealed</> is granted to you for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, increasing your <rt.warning>Main Stat</> by <rt.effect>7.2%</> / <rt.effect>12.8%</> / <rt.effect>18.4%</> / <rt.effect>24%</>.

You can not gain <rt.bold>Hidden Power</> stacks while <rt.bold>Power Revealed</> is active on you.

<rt.bold>(2.6 PPM)</>
name: Hidden Power

description:
The first hit of your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> triggers explosion of metal, <rt.warning>dealing damage equal to 40% of the hit that triggered it</> to the target and up to 7 additional nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Razor Shrapnel</> applies <rt.effect>Agonizing Wound</> to targets, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 5 seconds.
name: Razor Crash

description: The <rt.bold>absorb shield</> from your <rt.effect>Empowered Shield Slams</> takes <rt.bold>20% reduced damage</> & enemies that attack you while it is active take <rt.warning>50% Strength</> physical damage.
name: Unscarred Soul

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Charge</> ability triggers a free <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> upon impact.

Additionally, enemies that take damage from your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> deal <rt.bold>5% reduced physical damage</> to you for 5 seconds.
name: Vanguard's Advance

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Circle of Light</> creates a persistent area on the ground, causing all players standing in it to take <bold>10% reduced damage</>.

After 5 seconds, the area erupts in light, as a second <rt.absorb>Circle of Light</> of 50% power heals players in the area.
name: Ceremony of Light

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> grants <rt.heal>5% increased maximum health</> to targets while it is active on them.

Your <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</> deals <rt.warning>50% more damage</> and heals all players that have your <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> active on them for <rt.heal>50% of the damage dealt by</> <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</>.

Additionally, <rt.absorb>Dawnflare's</> <rt.bold>Cast Time</> is reduced by <rt.bold>0.1 seconds</> for <rt.bold>9 seconds</> each time you cast it. stacking up to a maximum of <rt.bold>0.5 seconds reduction</>.
name: Resplendent Dawn

description:
Your <rt.mana>Spirit Refunds</> grant you <rt.effect>Harmonizing Refractions</> for <rt.bold>18 seconds</>, causing your next cast of <rt.absorb>Soulbrand</>, <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</>, <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</>, or <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</> to have <rt.warning>50% increased power</>.

You can have up to <rt.bold>3 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Harmonizing Refractions</>.
name: Harmonizing Refractions

description: Your <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> lasts 2 seconds longer
name: Skandi's Decree

description:
Each tick of your <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> for 15 seconds, up to 30 stacks.

Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> consumes all stacks of <rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</>, increasing its damage by <rt.warning>30%</> per stack. Additionally, your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> hits <rt.bold>1 additional enemy</> near your target for each stack it consumes.

<rt.effect>Frostwyrm's Spite</> damage is reduced beyond 3 targets.
name: Frostwyrm's Spite

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Winter's Blessing</> grants you <rt.bold>2 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</>.

Your next ability that spends <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Undulating Spirits</> and always triggers a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>.

You start each dungeon with <rt.mana>50 Spirit Points</>.
name: Undulating Spirit

description:
<rt.bold>50% of any Overhealing</> done to a player by your <rt.absorb>Heartbloom</> is applied as an <rt.heal>Absorb</> to that player for up to 15 seconds.

Damage that is absorbed by <rt.absorb>Unyielding Bloom</> is <rt.heal>reduced by 50%</>.

The <rt.effect>Absorb</> generated by <rt.absorb>Unyielding Bloom</> can not exceed a value equal to <rt.heal>1000% of your Intellect</>.
name: Unyielding Bloom

description:
The <rt.effect>Sibling of Earth</> created by your <rt.absorb>Twin Souls: Bulwark</> ability has <rt.bold>50% increased health and duration</>.

The <rt.effect>Sibling of Earth</> accumulates <rt.warning>15%</> of all damage it takes and pulses it out to nearby enemies <rt.bold>up to 3 times</>, when reaching <rt.bold>65% Health</>, <rt.bold>30% Health</>, and finally upon being <rt.bold>destroyed</>.

If <rt.effect>Sibling of Earth</> expires due to its duration, it deals <rt.warning>15%</> of any remaining health it has.

The pulses from <rt.effect>Shattering Obelisk</> deal <rt.meikoability2>Wind Damage</>.

Damage is reduced beyond 1 targets.
name: Shattering Obelisk

description:
The <rt.bold>final strike</> of <rt.absorb>Earthfist Barrage</> deals <rt.warning>35% more damage</> and explodes the damage onto all <rt.bold>nearby enemies</>.

Damage is reduced beyond 1 target.
name: Tectonic Impact

description: Your <rt.absorb>Queen's Fang</> and <rt.absorb>Arachnid Assault</> critical strikes apply <rt.effect>Vexira's Venom</> to enemies, adding <rt.warning>{Damage} of the initial damage accumulatively</> as poison damage dealt over {Duration}.
name: Vexira's Venom

description: Each time you trigger a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>, you gain <rt.effect>Drenched in Blood</> for 8 seconds, <rt.warning>increasing your Expertise by +24%</>.
name: Drenched in Blood

description: After attacking from <rt.bold>Stealth</>, you gain <rt.effect>Assassin's Guile</> for 5 seconds, causing your <rt.absorb>Queen's Fang</> & <rt.absorb>Arachnid Assault</> to deal <rt.warning>40% more damage</>.
name: Assassin's Guile

description: Your Abilities have a <rt.bold>6% chance</> to grant you <rt.effect>Executioner's Grin</> for 8 seconds, causing your next <rt.absorb>Culling Strike</> to be useable on any target regardless of their health, and have no cost, and deal damage as if it spent <rt.mana>30 Fury</>.
name: Executioner's Grin

description: Enemies that take damage from your <rt.absorb>Leap Smash</> ability take <rt.warning>20% more damage from you for 6 seconds</>.
name: Slayer's Mosh

description:
Enemies hit by your <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> are afflicted by <rt.effect>Shimmer</> for <rt.bold>9 seconds</>, causing you to deal <rt.warning>8% more damage to them</>.

<rt.effect>Shimmer</> stacks up to <rt.bold>3 times</>.
name: Shimmer

description:
Your <rt.mana>Spirit Refunds</> have a <rt.bold>50% chance</> to reset the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Heartseeker Barrage</> and grant you <rt.effect>Impending Heartseeker</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>.

<rt.effect>Impending Heartseeker</> causes your next <rt.absorb>Heartseeker Barrage</> to deal <rt.warning>+10% increased damage</> with each arrow during its channel.
name: Starstriker's Ascent

description:
Conjures two interactable <rt.absorb>Portals</> that you and your allies can use to safely travel between two points.

<rt.meikoability2>Can only have 1 active portal at a time.</>
name: Conjure Portal

description:
Instantly turn your target into a chicken.

<rt.absorb>Chickenize!</> can only be used a limited amount of times per dungeon. The charges are shared by everyone in the party.

<rt.effect>Chickenized</> enemies <rt.warning>do not give Kill Score.</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Chickenize!

description:
Instantly conceal yourself all nearby allies, granting <rt.effect>Major Invisiblilty</> for 15 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can only be used out of combat.</>

<rt.effect>Fire Toad</> benefits from all bonuses that affect <rt.absorb>Fire Frogs</>.

<rt.bold>Expertise</>

name: Mount Axulian Prowler

description:
Each time you use <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shockwave</>, and <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>, you gain <rt.heal>3.0% increased Armor</> for 3 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Upon expiration, 1 stack is lost.

Your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals additional damage to all targets hit equal to <rt.warning>10% of your total Armor value</>.
name: Gleaming Shield

description: Your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> grants an additional <rt.mana>10% Toughness</> and  <rt.warning>deals up to 30% increased damage</> based on how much  <rt.mana>Toughness</> you have.
name: Greater Shockwave

description:
Your <rt.bold>Successful Blocks</> have a <rt.bold>6% chance</> to grant you 2 stacks of <rt.effect>Punishing Strikes</>.

<rt.effect>Punishing Strikes</> causes your next <rt.absorb>Measured Strike</> to deal <rt.warning>100% increased damage</> and have <rt.absorb>100% increased Veteran of War</>.
name: Punishing Strikes

description:
Your <rt.bold>Block Chance is increased by 5%</>.

You gain another <rt.bold>5% Block Chance</> while <rt.absorb>Shields Up</> is active.
name: Guarded Veteran

description: Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> reduces damage taken by an <rt.heal>additional 5%</> on each <rt.mana>Toughness</> Tier.
name: Front Line Defender

description: Each time you <rt.bold>Block</> an attack, the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> is reduced by 0.2 seconds.
name: Master of War

description: When you are <rt.bold>below 80% health</>, you gain <rt.bold>+5% Block Chance</> and <rt.heal>20% increased Healing taken</>.
name: Defiance

description: Your <rt.absorb>Sweeping Strike's</> <rt.effect>Blood Rally</> lasts an additional 6 seconds, but its healing is reduced to <rt.heal>4% of your maximum health every 1 second</>.
name: Lingering Rush

description: <rt.bold>Every 3 casts</> of <rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</> grants you <rt.effect>Divine Light</>, causing your next <rt.absorb>Circle of Light</> to be <rt.mana>Free</> and have <rt.heal>100% increased healing</>.
name: Divine Light

description: Your <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> healing is <rt.heal>four times as effective</> when triggered by your <rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</>.
name: Shining Blast

description: Whille <rt.effect>Runic Proliferation</> is active, your <rt.absorb>Soulbrand</>, <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</>, and <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> is cast on up to 4 targets at 120% power, as long as you have <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</> to spend.
name: Grand Proliferation

description: <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal's</> healing, <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier's</> absorb, and <rt.absorb>Soulbrand's</> damage is increased by 25%.
name: Radiant Soul

description:
When you cast <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</>, and while it is active, each <rt.mana>Radiant Rune</> you spend causes a free <rt.absorb>Greater Heal</> of 25% efficiency to be cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health.

The additional heals triggered by <rt.effect>Dawn Strider</> do not trigger <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> healing.
name: Dawn Strider

description: Your <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal's</> <rt.heal>initial heal is increased by 100%</> when healing an ally that already has <rt.effect>Rune of Renewal</> active on them..
name: Greater Renewal

description: Each tick of <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> has a  <rt.bold>7% chance</> to cast <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> on the target.
name: Cold Shower

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> is replaced with <rt.absorb>Talon Strike</>

Your <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> is replaced with <rt.absorb>Rising Talons</>.

Both abilities spend all <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> and conjure ice spikes under the feet of the target/targets repeatedly, based on how many <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> was spent.

Each <rt.absorb>Talon Strike</> ice spike deals <rt.warning>40% of Glacial Blast damage</>.

Each <rt.absorb>Rising Talons</> ice spike deals <rt.warning>40% of Ice Comet damage</>.

<rt.absorb>Talon Strike</> benefits from talents that affect <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</>.

<rt.absorb>Rising Talons</> benefits from talents that affect <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>.
name: Icy Talons

description:
Each tick of <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> has a chance to make your next <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> cast 3 <rt.absorb>Nettlebolts</> at once.

(2.0 PPM)
name: Sprouting Nettles

description: Your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> has <rt.heal>25% increased healing</> on targets that have <rt.absorb>Flutterfly: Restore Life</> active.
name: Shimmering Wings

description:
Each time your <rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> deal damage, your <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> <rt.heal>triggers an additional tick of its healing at 25% power</>.

Your <rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> deal <rt.warning>12% more damage</> for each player that has a <rt.effect>Pink Flutterfly</>.
name: Symbiosis

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</>, <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</>, <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</>, <rt.absorb>Shroomsplosion</>, <rt.absorb>Life Petal</>, and <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> casts grant you <rt.effect>Every Other Flutter</> for 8 seconds.

<rt.effect>Every Other Flutter</> causes your next cast of <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> to have <rt.mana>25% reduced Mana cost</>.
name: Every Other Flutter

description: The first four pulses of <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> have <rt.heal>50% increased healing</>.
name: In Bloom

description:
When your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> or <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> heals an ally at 50% health or below they gain <rt.effect>Saving Grace</> for 8 seconds.

<rt.effect>SAVING GRACE</>
The <bold>healing over time portion</> of your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> and <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> is <rt.heal>100% more powerful on allies with</> <rt.effect>Saving Grace</>.

<rt.effect>Saving Grace</> can not be applied more than once every 30 seconds.
name: Saving Grace

description:
Once the <rt.effect>Sibling of Earth</> created by your <rt.absorb>Twin Souls:Bulwark</> expires or is destroyed, you gain <rt.effect>Earthen Skin</> for <rt.bold>60 seconds</>, granting you <rt.bold>80% more Armor</>.

You deal <rt.warning>20% more</> <rt.meikoability2>Wind Damage</>.

Your <rt.absorb>Stone Shield</> and <rt.absorb>Shatter Earth</> deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</>.
name: Earthen Skin

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Backstab</> has a <rt.bold>30% chance</> to apply <rt.effect>Caustic Poison</> outside of <rt.absorb>Brooding Shadows</> if the target has <rt.effect>Hemorrhaging Strike's Bleed</> active on them.

<rt.effect>CREEPING DEATH</>
<rt.absorb>Caustic Poison</> deals <rt.warning>0.5% increased</> <rt.effect>Poison damage</> for every <rt.warning>1% Haste you have</>.
name: Caustic Wounds

description:
Each time your <rt.effect>Seething Poison</> deals damage to an enemy, it has a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to erupt, dealing <rt.warning>150% Agility</> poison damage to nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>CREEPING DEATH</>
<rt.absorb>Seething Burst</> deals <rt.warning>0.5% increased</> <rt.effect>Poison damage</> for every <rt.warning>1% Haste you have</>.
name: Seething Burst

description: Your <rt.absorb>Entropy's Claim</> now has <rt.effect>Deferred Fate: Mass Relay</>, causing it to <rt.heal>heal up to 4 allies for 50% of any damage it deals</>.
name: Karmic Dispersion

description: The <rt.heal>Healing</> caused by your <rt.effect>Deferred Fate: Relay</> and <rt.effect>Deferred Fate: Mass Relay</> <rt.heal>is increased by 10%</>.
name: Vestige of Eternity

description:
Your offensive abilities have a <rt.bold>8% chance</> to reset the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> and grant you <rt.bold>2 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Kill Em All</> for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>

While <rt.effect>Kill Em All</> is active, your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> has <rt.meikoability2>+60% Cooldown Acceleration</>.

Your next <rt.Absorb>Heavy Strike</> consumes <rt.bold>1 stack</> of <rt.effect>Kill Em All</>, causing it to deal <rt.warning>150% more damage</>.
name: Kill Em All

description: Your <rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> deals <rt.warning>+65% increased damage</> for each unique enemy other than your target that it hits.
name: The Motherload

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> grants you <rt.bold>1 stack</> of <rt.effect>Square Hammer</> for 20 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Your next <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> or <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> consumes all stacks, reducing the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Thunder Call</> by <rt.bold>1 second per stack</>.

Each time you consume <rt.effect>Square Hammer</> you are granted <rt.warning>+5% Expertise</> for <rt.bold>4 seconds</>.
name: Square Hammer

description:
Each time your <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> and <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> deals damage to an enemy you have a <rt.bold>Chance</> (3.0 PPM) to cast a free <rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> at them.

Your <rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> now has <rt.bold>2 charges</>.
name: Ace of Spades

description:
Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Detonate</> you gain 1 stack of <rt.effect>Cascading Inferno</>, up to 12 stacks.

<rt.effect>Cascading Inferno</>
When you have at least <rt.bold>4 stacks</> your next <rt.absorb>Infernal Wave</> is <rt.bold>Instant Cast</>, has <rt.warning>+100% Critical Strike chance</>, and generates <rt.mana>twice the amout of Cinders</>.

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a <rt.warning>grievous critical strike</>. <rt.warning>Grievous critical strikes</> increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.
name: Cascading Inferno

description: <rt.absorb>Start each Dungeon</> with <rt.mana>50 Spirit Points</> and <rt.mana>2 Burning Embers</>.
name: Burning Initiative

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Apocalypse</> has <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> reduced cast time and grants you <rt.bold>2 stacks</> of <rt.effect>Apocalyptic Surge</> for 18 seconds, up to <rt.bold>4 stacks maximum</>.

Your next <rt.absorb>Detonate</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Apocalyptic Surge</> and is <rt.mana>Free</>.
name: Apocalyptic Surge

description: Your <rt.absorb>Focused Shot</> and <rt.absorb>Celestial Shot</> deal <rt.warning>100% more damage</> but <rt.absorb>Focused Shot</> generates 50% less <rt.mana>Focus</>.
name: Deadly Focus

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Striker's Aim</> for every <rt.effect>Ricochet</> that does not find its target, granting you <rt.warning>+2% Expertise</> per stack.

Every <rt.bold>2 seconds</> 1 stack of <rt.effect>Striker's Aim</> is removed.

<rt.effect>Striker's Aim</> is only reapplied if missing <rt.effect>Ricochets</> exceed the current effect stack count.
name: Striker's Aim

description: The cooldown of <rt.absorb>Lunarlight Mark</> is <rt.bold>reduced by 2 seconds</> each time you cast <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</>.
name: Rising Moon

description: The cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> is reduced by <rt.bold>0.5 seconds</> each time it deals damage.
name: Swift Reload

name: The Gryphon

name: The Oak

name: The Lake

Deals <rt.warning>{SweepStrkDirect}</> physical damage to your target and other nearby enemies and grants you <rt.effect>Blood Rally</> for {BloodRushDuration} seconds, <rt.heal>healing you for {BloodRushHeal} of your maximum Health every {BloodRushPeriod}</>.

Enemies hit by <rt.absorb>Sweeping Strike</> bleed for <rt.warning>{SweepStrikDot}</> physical damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SweepStrikePeriod}</><rt.bold> seconds for 12 seconds</>.
name: Sweeping Strike

description:
Perform a heavy strike, dealing <rt.warning>{PwrStrkDirect}</> physical damage to target.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Power Strike</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> and <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abilities by 2 seconds.
name: Power Strike

description:
Raise your shield, increasing your <rt.mana>Toughness by 30%</> and increasing your <rt.meikoability1>Block chance by 25%</> for 12 sec.

<rt.absorb>Shields Up</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.meikoability1>Each time you succesfully Block an attack, you generate</> <rt.mana>3% Toughness</>.

<rt.mana>TOUGHNESS</>
<rt.mana>Toughness</> is displayed as a bar to the right of your character. The more Toughness you have, the less damage Helena takes. Your <rt.mana>maximum Toughness value (</><rt.heal>{MaxToughness}</><rt.mana>) is equal to {StrCoefficient} strength. Every 1% of Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit you have further increases the final amount by 2%</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Shields Up

description:
Throw your shield at target enemy dealing <rt.warning>{ShieldThrwDirect}</> physical damage. The shield bounces to up to 5 additional nearby enemies.

Each time <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> deals damage it generates <rt.mana>Toughness relative to the damage dealt</>.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> ability by 3.0 seconds.
name: Shield Throw

description:
Conjure an orb of light that slowly travels forward, healing all allies it touches for {DawnOrbHeal} and damaging enemies for <rt.warning>{DawnOrbDmg}</>. The power of <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb's</> damage and healing is affected by the target's maximum health. The higher maximum health the target has, the more damage or healing it does.

Each ally and enemy touched by <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</> generates <rt.mana>8% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour conjures an orb of intricate runes, humming with radiant power. The orb shines brilliantly as it slowly drifts forward, burning all darkness from its path and bolstering the lifeforce of Vigour's allies.</>
name: Dawnbreaker Orb

description:
Educate a target, <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 2 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Throw Book

description:
Apply a searing rune to target enemy, instantly dealing <rt.warning>{RemnantDamage}</> magic damage to them, plus an additional <rt.warning>{SoulbrandTickDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SoulbrandPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds over 24 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Soulbrand</> generates <rt.mana>30% of a Radiant Rune</> and <rt.mana>1% Maximum Mana</> over its duration.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>. 

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a searing rune onto the soul of his enemy, infusing it with radiant energy. The rune pulses painfully, steadily draining their life force while fueling Vigour’s power.</>
name: Soulbrand

description:
Instantly heal target ally for {RenewalHealDirect} and apply <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> on them for 30 seconds, causing all your direct healing effects on that ally to echo for an additional <rt.heal>35% of the initial heal's value</>.

The bonus healing generated by <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> generates <rt.mana>Radiant Rune</> resource relative to the value of the heal.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a resonating rune onto the spirit of an ally. When Vigor heals that ally, the rune pulses gently, further mending any wounds that linger as its light nourishes the body and spirit.</>
name: Rune of Renewal

description:
Apply a shield to target ally that absorbs up to <rt.heal>{LuminousAbsorb}</> damage. <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> lasts for up to <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

Damage absorbed by <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> is <rt.heal>reduced by {LuminousDmgRed}</>.

<rt.effect>RESIDUAL LUMINOSITY</>
When <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> expires or is removed from a player, they gain <rt.effect>Residual Luminosity</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, <rt.heal>reducing all damage taken by 15%</>.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>. 

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a rune of protection onto an ally, causing light to be woven around them into a barrier of divine energy. The barrier stops all forms of attack, whether forged by steel or conjured by magic.</>
name: Luminous Barrier

description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.
detail: Bosses sometimes cast more powerful <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> that are <rt.debuff>Immune</> to <rt.bold>Dispel.</>
name: Remove Magic

description:
Instantly heal all allies within a large radius of you for {AvatarDirectHeal} and enter an enlightened state for 9 sec, enhancing your abilities.

<rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</>
Deals <rt.warning>50% increased damage</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.

<rt.absorb>Heal</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and is <rt.bold>Instant Cast</>.

<rt.absorb>Circle of Light</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.


<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>
name: Avatar of Light

description:
Instantly generate <rt.mana>3 Radiant Runes</>. For the next 8 seconds, any <rt.absorb>Rune Abilities</> you cast are empowered, increasing their effectiveness by 20%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Runic Proliferation

description:
Your movement speed is increased by 70% for 5 seconds and you take <rt.bold>40% reduced Area of Effect damage</> for the duration.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting or Channeling</>
name: Levitate

description:
Deals <rt.warning>{DawnflareDmg}</> magic damage to target enemy.

Each cast of <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</> generates <rt.mana>20% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour can call upon the light to unleash a flare of divine light from above. This flash of radiant energy strikes the enemy with a sharp but controlled force.</>
name: Dawnflare

description:
Summon <rt.effect>5 Frost Swallows</> to circle above Rime for 20 seconds. Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> and <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> command the frost swallows to swoop down on enemies, each dealing <rt.warning>{FrostSwallDmg}</> damage to their target.

<rt.bold>For every 1% Spirit you have</>, your <rt.absorb>Frost Swallows</> deal <rt.warning>1.5% more damage</>.

<rt.greyitalic>"She needed only whisper, and the Navir appeared."</>
name: Flight of the Navir

description: Your <rt.absorb>Frost Ward</> duration is increased by 2 seconds and while it is active, you heal for 50% of all damage you deal.
name: Frost Ward (Tundra Guard)

description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Frost Ward

description: Unleash a large <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> from above target enemy to crash down on them, dealing <rt.warning>{IceComet}</> damage to all enemies caught in the impact radius.
name: Ice Comet

description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Brain Freeze

description:
Assault the target with extreme cold, dealing <rt.warning>{ColdSnap}</> damage. 

<rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.mana>Generates 1 Winter Orb</>

<rt.mana>WINTER ORBS</>
<rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</>, <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>, and <rt.absorb>Flight of the Navir</>.
name: Cold Snap

description:
Blast enemies in front of you with arctic winds, <rt.absorb>Knocking Back</> enemies and <rt.absorb>Slowing</> them by 50% for 12 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Frigid Winds

description:
Invoke the spirits of the frozen tundra for 20 seconds, granting you <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</> every 4 seconds. You deal <rt.warning>+20% increased damage</> and your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> ability is instant cast while <rt.absorb>Wrath of Winter</> is active.

<rt.mana>WINTER ORBS</>
<rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> and <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>.

<rt.effect>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>
name: Wrath of Winter

description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Ice Dash

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit is increased by 20%</> for 20 seconds and <rt.heal>30% of all damage you deal is replicated as healing</> divided equally between all allies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Winter's Blessing

description:
Flay your target with a beam of frost energy, dealing <rt.warning>{FreezeTorrTickDmg}</> damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{FreezeTorrPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 2 seconds</> while channeling. 

<rt.mana>Generates 1 Anima per tick</>

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.
name: Freezing Torrent

description: Hurl a mass of ice at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{GlacialBlast}</> damage.
name: Glacial Blast

description:
Hurl a bolt of frost magic at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{FrostBolt}</> damage.

<rt.mana>Generates 3 Anima</> 

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.
name: Frost Bolt

description:
Conjures an icy crystal inside a target that pulses frost damage, dealing <rt.warning>{BurstIceTickDmg}</> <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{BurstIcePeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 3 seconds</> to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</>
While <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> is active on an enemy you gain <rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</>, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</>. <rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</> does not affect <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</>.

<rt.mana>Each pulse of</> <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> <rt.mana>Generates 1 Anima</>

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.
name: Bursting Ice

description:
You enter a state of focused casting for 20 seconds, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</> for the duration.

The duration of <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> is extended by 0.1 seconds each time a <rt.absorb>Frost Swallow</> hits an enemy.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting</>
name: Ice Blitz

description: Rime commands Frost Swallows to attack her target.
name: Frost Swallows

description:
Command one of your <rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> to <rt.effect>Enfeeble</> target enemy, reducing all damage that enemy deals by 20% for 10 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown.</>

The <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> withers upon completing it's cast of <rt.absorb>Enfeebling Rootsap</>.
name: Enfeebling Rootsap

description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.
name: Cure Ailment

description:
Call upon <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> to protect up to 4 players by evenly distributing all health between them every 1.5 seconds over 12 sec.

Upon arriving, the <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> cause <rt.absorb>6 Prickly Vines</> to spontaneously  spawn near you.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>
name: Fluttercall: Jubilee

description:
Summon a <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> for 27 seconds to continuously fling thorns at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{PricklyVineDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{PricklyVinePeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>.

For each <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> you have active, all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> is <rt.heal>increased by 3%</>.

<rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> deal increased damage equal to your Haste.

Each <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> spawns <rt.effect>1 Boomshroom</> when it withers.
name: Prickly Vine

description: Place a <rt.absorb>Safe Haven</> in target location. For the next 15 seconds, all allies standing within the radius have <rt.absorb>40% increased healing taken</>.
name: Safe Haven

description:
Assign one of your <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to an ally, healing them for {FlutterHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{FlutterHealPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> until it is called away.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.
name: Fluttercall: Heal

description:
Beckon two <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to dance around target ally. <rt.bold>After</> <rt.heal>{RestoreLifeDelay}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>, the target is instantly healed for {RestoreLifeDirectHeal} plus an additional {RestoreLifeHotHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{RestoreLifeHotPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> for 15 seconds.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.
name: Fluttercall: Restore Life

description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Demure</>
Upon activating <rt.absorb>Hidden Trail</> your threat is reduced by 50% with all enemies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Hidden Trail

description:
A <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> sprouts up near you, healing one ally for {LifePetalTickHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{LifePetalPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> for 14 seconds, preferring the ally with the lowest health.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal's</> healing wanes over time, healing for less the longer it has been active.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal</> spawns <rt.effect>2 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.
name: Life Petal

description:
Command all mature <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> to attack causing them to leap at target enemy and explode, dealing <rt.warning>{ShroomSplDmg}</> magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</>
Each time one of your plants expire, budding <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> start growing in that location. After 3 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Boomshroom</> has reached full maturity and is ready to be called into battle.
name: Shroomsplosion

description:
Conjure a <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> at your side that stores <rt.meikoability1>12% of all Flutterfly healing</> you do inside it.

Every 2 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 16 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> spawns <rt.effect>3 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.
name: Heart Bloom

description:
Cast a bolt of nettles at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{NettleDmg}</> damage to them.

<rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> replenishes the <rt.mana>Mana Cost</> it spends once it deals damage to an enemy.

<rt.Absorb>Petal Germination</>
The cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> is reduced by 1.5 seconds each time you deal damage with <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> and 3 seconds if it critically strikes.
name: Nettlebolt

description:
Send your <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> to protect target ally.

While your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is attached to an ally, that player receives <rt.heal>100% increased healing</> from your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> effects.

While the <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is on you, Your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> on all allies is <rt.heal>increased by 50%</> and all your abilities have <rt.mana>20% reduced mana cost</>.
name: Fluttercall: Protect

description:
Recall your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> to you.

While the <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is on you, Your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> on all allies is <rt.heal>increased by 50%</> and all your abilities have <rt.mana>20% reduced mana cost</>.

While your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is attached to an ally, that player receives <rt.heal>100% increased healing</> from your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> effects.
name: Fluttercall: Embrace

description:
Split your soul into the <rt.meikoability2>Sibling of Wind</> and the <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth</> for up to 20 seconds. You are in control of the <rt.meikoability2>Sibling of Wind</>.

<rt.meikoability3>SIBLING OF EARTH</>
While active, the <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth</> forces all enemies within a 1000 radius to attack it. The <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth's</> Health <rt.heal>({TotemMaxHealth})</> is equal to your maximum health, increased by 2% for every 1% Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit you have.
name: Twin Souls: Bulwark

description: Meiko receives 200% of the damage done by her Sucker Punch as Absorption.
name: Shield of Pain

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Double Palm Strike</> finisher applies <bold>Forbidden Technique</> to the target for 15 seconds.

<bold>Forbidden Technique</> accumulates 18% of all damage you deal to the target. Once it expires, is removed, or if the enemy dies while it is active -  the accumulated amount explodes on the target and onto nearby enemies. You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by <bold>Forbidden Technique</>.

You can only have one <bold>Forbidden Technique</> active at any time.
name: Forbidden Technique

description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Taunt

description:
Grants access to <rt.mana>Finishing Moves</>  based on <rt.mana>Combo Builders</> used:

<rt.meikoability2>Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.meikoability1>PALM TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability1>Double Palm Strike</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Grants <rt.bold>+20% Magic Damage reduction</> & <rt.bold>+5% Parry</> for 30 sec.
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Vortex</>  (CORE ABILITY)
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides <rt.bold>+15% Dodge</>, deals damage to nearby enemies over 30 seconds, and reduces their movement speed by 35% for 5 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>KICK TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability2>Rising Storm</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Stormfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
<rt.meikoability2>Lashing Stormkick</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

<rt.meikoability3>FIST TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability3>Rising Earth</> (CORE ABILITY)
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Earthfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
<rt.meikoability3>Earthfist Barrage</> (POWER ABILITY)
• Pummels target enemy over 1 second and heals you for 50% of the damage it deals.

description:
Deals <rt.warning>{EarthFistDmg}</> damage to target enemy.

Grants access to <rt.meikoability3>Fist Technique</> finishers.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>
name: Earth Fist

Deals <rt.warning>{SpiritPalmDmg}</> damage to target enemy.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>

Deals <rt.warning>{WindKickDmg}</> damage to your target and other enemies near your target.

Grants access to <rt.meikoability2>Kick Technique</> finishers.

<rt.mana>Combo Builder</>

Perform a powerful jump kick, dealing <rt.warning>{RisingStrmDmg}</> damage to your target and nearby enemies. Grants you 2 charges of <rt.mana>Stormfall</>.

<rt.absorb>Stormfall</>
Your next <rt.bold>Lashing Stormkick</> deals 100% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Rising Storm

Uppercut target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{RisingEarthDmg}</>. Grants you 2 charges of <rt.mana>Earthfall</>.

<rt.absorb>Earthfall</>
Your next <rt.bold>Earthfist Barrage</> deals 100% increased damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Rising Earth

description:
Strike target enemy with both palms, dealing <rt.warning>{DoublePalmDmg}</> damage. Grants <rt.absorb>Spirited Strikes</> for 30 seconds.

<rt.absorb>SPIRITED STRIKES</>
+20% Magic Damage Reduction
+5% Parry

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

Perform a roundhouse kick, dealing <rt.warning>{LashStrmDmg}</> damage to your target and nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Lashing Stormkick</> heals you for <rt.heal>50% of the damage it deals</>.

<rt.bold>AFFECTED BY STORMFALL</>
<rt.absorb>Lashing Stormkick</> deals <rt.warning>+100% increased damage</> when it can consume a stack of <rt.mana>Stormfall</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Lashing Stormkick

description:
Send a shockwave through the ground in front of you, dealing <rt.warning>{StoneStompDmg}</> damage to enemies in its wake and <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 3 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Stone Stomp

You split your soul into the <rt.meikoability2>Sibling of Wind</> and the <rt.meikoability3>Sibling of Earth</> for 20 seconds. You deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</> for the duration.

<rt.meikoability3>SIBLING OF EARTH (controlled)</>
While <rt.absorb>Twin Souls: Army of One</> is active, the Sibling of Earth takes <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</>.

<rt.meikoability2>SIBLING OF WIND</>

<rt.absorb>Earthfist Barrage</> heals you for <rt.heal>50% of the damage it deals</>.

<rt.bold>AFFECTED BY EARTHFALL</>
<rt.absorb>Earthfist Barrage</> deals <rt.warning>+100% increased damage</> when it can consume a stack of <rt.mana>Earthfall</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Earthfist Barrage

description:
Instantly heal yourself for <rt.heal>{SerenityHeal}</>.

Each time you <rt.bold>Auto Attack</> an enemy, your <rt.absorb>Serenity</> gains <rt.heal>+40% increased healing</>, stacking up to 50 times.

Meiko creates a vortex of winds around her, providing <rt.mana>+15% Dodge Chance</> and dealing <rt.warning>{SpiritVortexDmg}</> damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SpiritVortexPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 30 seconds</> to all nearby enemies.

description:
Summon 3 protective stones around you that spin in a wide circle, dealing <rt.warning>{StoneShieldDmg}</> physical damage <rt.warning>4 times</> to all nearby enemies.

Your armor is increased by <rt.bold>20%</> for every 1 stone that is active on you, up to a maximum of <rt.bold>60%</> increased armor with 3 stones.

While at least one stone is active, they <rt.heal>soak 35% of all damage you take</>.

<rt.mana>Each stone has a health value (</><rt.heal>{StoneShieldHealth}</><rt.mana>) equal to {AgiCoefficient} agility. Every 1% of Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit you have further increases the final amount by 2%</>.

<rt.absorb>Stone Shield</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Stone Shield

description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

description:
Instantly enter <rt.absorb>Stealth</>, making it difficult for enemies to detect you. When used in combat, <rt.absorb>Brooding Shadows</> triggers its cooldown.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.absorb>Brooding Shadows</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.absorb>CORE</>
Your <rt.absorb>Backstab</>, <rt.absorb>Widow's Bite</> and <rt.absorb>Skittering Blades</> abilities each apply poison when used from stealth. This has changed <rt.absorb>Backstab</> and <rt.absorb>Skittering Blades</> to become <rt.absorb>CORE</> abilities.

<rt.absorb>Backstab - Caustic Poison:</>
Instantly deal <rt.warning>{CausticDmg}</> poison damage and generate <rt.meikoability1>6 Combo Points</>. <rt.absorb>Caustic Poison</> has <rt.warning>+100% Critical Strike chance</>.

<rt.absorb>Widow's Bite - Seething Poison:</>
Applies Seething Poison to the target, dealing <rt.warning>{SeethingDmg}</> poison damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SeetingPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 60 seconds</>. While Seething Poison is active on any enemy, it takes <rt.warning>20% more damage</> from your <rt.absorb>Hemorrhaging Strike Bleed</> and you gain <rt.effect>Predator's Rush</>, granting you <rt.mana>20% increased Energy Regeneration</>. Seething Poison <rt.bold>can only be active on 1 target at a time</>.

<rt.absorb>Skittering Blades - Volatile Poison</>:
Applies Volatile Poison to all enemies hit by your Skittering Blades, dealing <rt.warning>{VolatileTotalDmg}</> poison damage over 6 seconds. Upon expiration, Volatile Poison erupts dealing <rt.warning>{VolatileAoeDmg}</> poison damage to the target.

<rt.effect>CREEPING DEATH</>
<rt.absorb>Caustic Poison</>, <rt.absorb>Seething Poisons</>, and <rt.absorb>Volatile Poison</> deal <rt.warning>0.5% increased</> <rt.effect>Poison damage</> for every <rt.warning>1% Haste you have</>.
name: Brooding Shadows

description: Each time your <rt.effect>Seething Poison</> deals damage to an enemy, it has a <rt.bold>20% chance</> to erupt, dealing <rt.warning>150% Agility</> poison damage to them.

Swing your hammer in a wide arc toward target enemy dealing <rt.warning>{WildSwingDmg}</> physical damage to it and any nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> also charges the ground in front of you with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeLightnDmg}</> lightning damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt if used in hit window</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be queued during Global Cooldown</>


<rt.meikoability2>Swing Timer</>
Your swing timer is displayed as a bar to the right of your hero. When you see the red area light up on the swing timer it is time to queue your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> and wait for it to finish.

<rt.meikoability2>Queueing Heavy Strike</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike's</> queue is displayed as a golden border around the ability icon on your action bar. The queue is canceled when you use any other ability, so make sure the last button you press before the swing timer reaches the end of the red area is Heavy Strike.

name: Brilliant Flash

description:
Rupture the ground in front of you,  dealing <rt.warning>{RisingSunDmg}</> magical damage to all enemies in a cone in front of you, <rt.effect>Stunning</> them for 2 seconds and <rt.effect>Pulling</> them to you.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Ruptured Dawn

description:
Your sword is infused with the light of sun power as you slash at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{BlindSlashDmg}</> physical damage to them and other enemies near it.

<rt.effect>BLIND</>
You apply 1 stack of <rt.effect>Blind</> to enemies hit by <rt.absorb>Blinding Slash</> for up to 8 seconds, causing their Auto Attacks to have an additional <rt.bold>+20% chance to be Parried by you</>. Each time you Parry an enemy, 1 stack of <rt.effect>Blind</> is consumed on that enemy.

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Blinding Slash</> has a 15% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.
name: Blinding Slash

description:
Sunlight envelopes the ground at your feet, burning enemies within its area for <rt.warning>{ShiningHaloDmg}</> magical damage every <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> over <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

You take <rt.heal>20% reduced damage</> while standing in your <rt.absorb>Shining Halo</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>BRILLIANCE</>
While <rt.absorb>Shining Halo</> is active, each <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> you cast extends the duration of it by <rt.bold>2 seconds</>.
name: Shining Halo

description:
Heal target ally for {BrillFlareHeal} health.

<rt.effect>BRILLIANT FLASH</>
When you have a charge of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</> or <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</> your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> turns into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.
name: Brilliant Flare

description:
Instantly gain 2 stacks of <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</>, causing your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> with <rt.bold>added enhancements</> when used to consume the 2 stacks.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>Brilliant Flash: Enhanced</>
Your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> has <rt.warning>50% increased power</> on your <rt.bold>Main Target</> and <rt.mana>generates 12% maximum Mana</> for you.

When cast on a friendly target, <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> is also casted on <rt.bold>all party members</> within a large range of that ally.

When cast on an enemy, <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> is also casted on <rt.bold>all enemies</> within a large range of that enemy.

<rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</>.
name: Omega Reprieval

description:
Conjure blades of pure sunlight to fall from above upon your target, dealing <rt.warning>{SolarBladesDmg}</> magical damage to it and other enemies within a 700 radius.

The main target takes <rt.warning>100% more damage</> from <rt.absorb>Solar Blades</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Solar Blades</> has a 100% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.
name: Solar Blades

description:
Swing your sword in a large arc around you, dealing <rt.warning>{OmnistrikeDmg}</> physical damage to all enemies around you.

<rt.mana>Generates 4 Spirit Points</>.

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Omnistrike</> has a 30% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.
name: Omnistrike

description:
Instantly teleport forward a short distance and gain <rt.absorb>{movespeed} Movement Speed</> for {duration}.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting or channeling</>
name: Time Skip

description:
Erode the vitality of target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{ErodeVitalityTickDmg}</> magic damage every <rt.warning>{ErodeVitalityPeriod} seconds</> over <rt.bold>{ErodeVitalityDuration} seconds</> as their life force begins to slip away.

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: RELAY</>
100% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Entropy's Claim</> heals an ally within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>. The lowest health ally is preferred.

<rt.mana>Each time</> <rt.absorb>Entrropy's Claim</> <rt.mana>deals damage, it generates 4 Chrona.</>
<rt.mana>Critical Strike chance to generate 6 Chrona.</>
name: Entropy's Claim

description: Protect an ally in a Veil of Time and sand for X seconds, making them immune to all damage and removes the targets current threat.
name: Chrono Veil (OLD)

description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.
detail: Bosses sometimes cast more powerful <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> that are <rt.debuff>Immune</> to <rt.bold>Dispel.</>
name: Revert Magic

description:
Invoke the strands of time to reshape a pivotal moment. Time stops for the next <rt.bold>6 seconds</>, pausing all allies' health bars.

Any <rt.heal>Damage and Healing dealt during</> <rt.absorb>Epoch Break</> is <rt.heal>stored</> to be dealt all at once when <rt.absorb>Epoch Break</> expires.

During <rt.absorb>Epoch Break</>, your abilities have no <rt.mana>Mana</> or <rt.mana>Chrona</> costs.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>
name: Epoch Break

description:
Release splinters of ruinous energy into the target and up to 2 additional nearby enemies, dealing <rt.warning>{SplinterTickDmg}</> magic damage every <rt.warning>{SplinterPeriod} seconds</> over <rt.bold>{SplinterDuration} seconds</>. 

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: RELAY</>
100% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Echoes of Ruin</> heals an ally within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>. The lowest health ally is preferred.

<rt.mana>Generates 6 Chrona.</>
<rt.mana>Critical Strike chance to generate 9 Chrona.</>
name: Echoes of Ruin

description:
Hurl a fragment of condensed time at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{TimeShardDmg}</> magic damage to it.

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: RELAY</>
100% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Time Shard</> heals an ally within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>. The lowest health ally is preferred.

<rt.mana>Generates 6 Chrona.</>
<rt.mana>Critical Strike chance to generate 9 Chrona.</>
name: Time Shard

description:
Deliver a heavy strike of temporal energy to the target, dealing <rt.warning>{UnfoldDoomDmg}</> magic damage. <rt.effect>Unfolding Doom</> tears at the threads of their destiny, <rt.warning>increasing all damage you deal to them by 20% for 20 seconds</>.

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: RELAY</>
100% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Unfolding Doom</> heals an ally within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>. The lowest health ally is preferred.

<rt.mana>Generates 20 Chrona.</>
<rt.mana>Critical Strike chance to generate 30 Chrona.</>
name: Unfolding Doom

description: Summon Spirit of Akari, increasing your movement speed.
name: Mount Spirit of Akari

description: Summon Vilesoul Raptor, increasing your movement speed.
name: Mount Vilesoul Raptor

description:
Burns all enemies within a large radius for <rt.warning>{SolaceDmg}</> magical damage every <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> while active and increases your <rt.bold>Parry chance by +8%</>

<rt.absorb>Aura of Solace</> transfers <rt.heal>10% of all damage taken by nearby allies to you</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.mana>Costs 10 Mana every 1.5 seconds while active.</>
name: Aura of Solace

description:
Launch a series of bolts of temporal energy at a single target, each fracturing the flow of fate and turning the tide of battle in your favor.

Each bolt of <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> deals <rt.warning>{TemporBarrDmg}</> magic damage to an enemy or <rt.heal>{TemporBarrHeal}</> healing to an ally.

<rt.meikoability2>Can move while channeling</>

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: RELAY</>
100% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Temporal Barrage</> heals an ally within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>. The lowest health ally is preferred.

<rt.mana>Generates 4 Chrona per bolt.</>
<rt.mana>Critical Strike chance to generate 6 Chrona.</>
name: Temporal Barrage

description:
Borrow time to mend a single ally, healing them for {AeonaCastHeal}.

<rt.effect>Stagger</> is applied to the target for <rt.warning>{percentage} of the healing</> as temporal debt ripples through their being.

<rt.mana>Generates 5 Chrona.</>
name: Flash Revision

description:
Instantly smash the target for <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeDmg}</> physical damage and deal <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeClvDmg}</> physical damage to all enemies near the target.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> also charges the ground in front of you with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeLightnDmg}</> lightning damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.mana>Generates 12 Fury</>
name: Heavy Strike

description:
Grants <rt.heal>30% Damage Reduction</> to yourself for 9 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
name: Obsidian Skin

description:
Redesign an ally's fate as it unfolds, instantly <rt.bold>cleansing target ally</> of up to <rt.effect>{StaggerCleanse}</> accumulated <rt.effect>stagger</> stored in <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>.

<rt.absorb>Amend Fate</> heals the target for <rt.heal>{CleanHeal} of the amount cleansed</>.

<rt.effect>CONVERGING TIMELINES</>
Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Amend Fate</> you gain <rt.meikoability2>+100% Cooldown Acceleration</> for <rt.bold>0.5 seconds</>.

<rt.mana>Generates Mana based on the amount of Stagger cleansed</>
name: Amend Fate

description:
You step into the flow of time itself, and it quickens at your touch, granting you <rt.meikoability2>+50% Cooldown Acceleration</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>.

The cooldown of <rt.absorb>Fleeting Hour</> does not count down until its active duration ends.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting or channeling</>
name: Fleeting Hour

description:
Instantly unleash a concentrated pulse of destructive temporal energy at the target, shattering the threads of fate around them.

Deals <rt.warning>{ChronaBurstDmg}</> magic damage to the target.

<rt.effect>CONVERGING TIMELINES</>
Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Oblivion</> you gain <rt.meikoability2>+100% Cooldown Acceleration</> for <rt.bold>0.5 seconds</>.

<rt.effect>DEFERRED FATE: MASS RELAY</>
50% of any damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Oblivion</> heals all allies within your <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>.
name: Oblivion

description:
Rearrange the flow of events unfolding around you, instantly <rt.bold>cleansing all allies</> of up to <rt.effect>{StaggerCleanse}</> accumulated <rt.effect>stagger</> stored in <rt.absorb>Aura of Deferred Fate</>.

<rt.absorb>Restore Continuity</> heals each ally for <rt.heal>{CleanHeal} of the amount cleansed</>.

<rt.effect>CONVERGING TIMELINES</>
Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Restore Continuity</> you gain <rt.meikoability2>+100% Cooldown Acceleration</> for <rt.bold>0.5 seconds</>.

<rt.mana>Generates Mana based on the amount of Stagger cleansed</>
name: Restore Continuity

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> ability grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Glacial Assault</>. Once you have 4 stacks of <rt.effect>Glacial Assault</>, your next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> is <bold>instant cast</>, deals <rt.warning>40% more damage</> and has <rt.mana>no cost</>.

<rt.effect>Glacial Assault</> causes your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> to explode on impact, dealing <rt.warning>20% of the initial damage</> to nearby enemies.
name: Glacial Assault

Cleave all enemies in front of you, dealing {BloodArcDmg} and granting you <rt.effect>Serrated Edge</> for 10 seconds, causing your next damaging ability to transfer an additional <rt.warning>20%</> of its damage to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

<rt.effect>Serrated Edge</> does not interact with your <rt.absorb>Bloodbound Spirit</> ability.

Strike with immense power around you, consuming all <rt.warning>Rend</> stacks on enemies hit and applying <rt.effect>Slaughter</> to them.

<rt.effect>Slaughter</> is a bleed that deals <rt.warning>{Slaughter} of the total Rend damage</> consumed from each enemy, to each enemy over <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

Strike target enemy by driving both axes upwards through their torso and splitting their anatomy open, dealing {RuptureDmg} and applying <rt.effect>Open Wounds</> for <rt.bold>18 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Rupture</> applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the target for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

<rt.effect>Open Wounds</>
Your next <rt.absorb>Slaughter</> consumes <rt.effect>Open Wounds</>, <rt.warning>increasing</> <rt.absorb>Slaughter's</> <rt.warning>damage against that enemy by 20%</>.
name: Rupture

description:
Jump and strike at your enemy from above, dealing {ReckoningDmg} to the target.

<rt.warning>100%</> of the direct damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> is added to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

<rt.effect>Exsanguinate</>
<rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> exsanguinates the target's wounds, dealing an additional <rt.warning>{BonusOfRend}</> of the <rt.warning>Total Rend Damage</> active on the target.
name: Heart Splitter

description: For the next {duration}, your abilities apply an additional <rt.warning>{AddedTransfer} of the damage dealt</> to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

For the next <rt.bold>20 seconds</> your <rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> and <rt.absorb>Grim Carve</> deal <rt.warning>{BloodboundBuff} increased damage</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 seconds.</>
name: Bloodbound Spirit

description:
Each time <rt.warning>Rend</> deals damage there is a chance a <rt.effect>Blood Feather</> is spawned near the enemy on the ground that you can pick up to gain 1 stack of <rt.effect>Owed in Blood</> for 30 seconds, up to maximum of 150 stacks.

Enemies that die with your <rt.warning>Rend</> active on them have a 25% chance to create a <rt.effect>Blood Feather</>.

When you use your <rt.absorb>Owed in Blood</> ability, all stacks of <rt.effect>Owed in Blood</> you have accumulated from <rt.effect>Blood Feathers</> are applied to the targeted enemy as <rt.warning>Rend</> stacks.
name: Owed in Blood
