description: Coveted mounts of Drakheim’s champions, these warbears were famed for their unmatched ferocity and loyalty. Their legend is sealed in tragedy, as most fell beside their masters when the Bleakfrost Orcs arrived.
name: Drakheim Warbear

description: A powerful bear native to Vidahl, famed for its aggression and often seen wading into the highland streams to snatch salmon in its claws.
name: Woodpaw Grizzly

description: Only the Urrak dare to break the will of the Bloodfangs, the savage hunters of the Tuzari Wilds.
name: Bloodfang Matriarch

description: Sleek and silent predators haunt the highland crags. Merchants superstitiously avoid travelling the days surrounding the new moon, when these panthers are believed to be most active.
name: Midnight Panther

description: A bloodfang twisted by the awakening of Baphumos. It is now a vessel of demonic hunger.
name: Corrupted Bloodfang

description: A black, imposing warhorse bred for battle. They are coveted for their strength and stubborn endurance on long campaigns.
name: Obsidian Warhorse

description: An adventurer can find no better companion than a Vidahlian horse bred for courage, endurance, and strength.
name: Vidahlian Warhorse

description: Even clad in armor, these golden steeds remain swift and tireless. Their rosy barding declares a wish for peace and a warning that the rider will fight if pressed
name: Palomino Warhorse

description: Overconfident kings often become easily identifiable targets riding pristine white horses into battle.
name: Alabaster Warhorse

description: A dark and striking steed, its aggressive temperment and thunderous gait make it a favored mount among mercenaries.
name: Obsidian Charger

description: A sturdy adventurer’s horse, native to the Vidahlian Highlands.
name: Vidahlian Courser

description: A rare breed with a subtle blue sheen to its coat, treasured by spellcasters as the most magical of the non-magical steeds.
name: Roan Stallion

description: A swift golden horse, favored by scouts and couriers for its tireless speed across open plains.
name: Palomino Runner

description: A noble horse whose white coat gleams like polished stone, prized by knights and nobility.
name: Alabaster Steed

description: Warhorses raised into eternal service through necromantic rites, Deathchargers thunder across the fields of Cadavria. Though born of shadow, they are bartered by its lords to the living in exchange for artifacts of power.
name: Raging Deathcharger

description: This creature appears by riversides, inviting the lost to ride upon its back.
name: Bäckahäst

description: A giant black rat that lurked in the cellar of the Heroes’ Rest Inn for years. This low-level menace to young adventurers has proven its value in being able to bear a rider.
name: Squeaks

description: A fantastic and daring rat on a long journey to join the Fellowship.
name: Sir Bombastic

description: A nearly extinct spider known to haunt the southern cliffs of Vidahl where they snare gryphons mid-flight in their immense webs. Their webbing is nearly invisible in daylight as to be unseen by a gryphons' keen eyesight.
name: Nightveil Widow

lore: An immense spirit-bear that haunts the woodland paths, guiding lost travelers to safety and driving away those who would despoil the forest.
A golden phantom panther, said to appear only before the pure of heart. Its presence banishes fear, a beacon of light in the wild dark.
A vengeful red specter of a rat, swollen by rage for its cellar-kin slain by fledgling adventurers.

description: The undead crew of the Carrion Dread breed stowaway bilgerats for entertainment. After Bael'aurum's defeat, this one seems to have contended himself on the treasures within the vault.
name: Gilded Hoarder

description: A dire rat imbued with the power of the storm. Once thought dead by a Stronghold scout, it revived with crackling energy and was brought back alive, more curiosity than threat.
name: Stormstruck Rat

description: Tigers that prowl Wraithtide Isle are said to have descended from beasts once marooned by shipwrecked merchants who hoped to sell them as exotic prizes. Now, they flourish as the isle’s apex hunters.
name: Wraithtide Huntress

description: Horses that pass through the Wyrdwoods emerge touched by primal forces. Plants stretch toward them as though greeting kin, and their riders claim the forest itself moves to guard their steps.
name: Wyrdwood Warhorse

description: A bloated albino rat grown fat on the Stronghold’s larders. Once a familiar pest of the Inn, it has long since worn out its welcome, but refuses to leave.
name: Cheesers

description: Sorcerors may sometimes elect for non-magical means of transportation when trying to cross great distances discretely. Their flair for the peculiar often betrays them.
name: Arcanist's Warhorse

description: Used for Playtest Gear Dispersal
Used for Playtest Gear Dispersal
Used for Playtest Gear Dispersal
Seasonal Gear for Winter Holiday
name: Warm Wishes

description: When the Solstice thins the veil, Winter Spirits walk the realm. Brum, the Spirit of Winter Warmth, appears as a great bear adorned in wreaths and gentle light. His presence softens frost and brings cheer wherever he roams.
name: Brum the Winter Warmth

description: Folkmages use simple winter cantrips to warm riders and saddles for long journeys through the cold. These enchanted draft horses glow faintly in frost, carrying travelers safely across snowbound roads. They are steady companions touched by humble hearth magic.
name: Warmheart Drafthorse

description: In the Goremdal Mountains, wolves change their coats with the seasons. In winter, they turn radiant white and vanish into the snow as silent hunters of the long night. A Whitemane’s loyalty is rare, but their strength is unmatched.
name: Whitemane Wolf

description: Descended from Volsyr, the fire-forged wolf god. Cindermaw's breath trails smoke, and his eyes burn with ember-bright resolve.
name: Cindermaw

description: The Vilesoul Raptor is particularly brutal, imbued with dark magic.
name: Vilesoul Raptor

description: Beneath the twisted canopy of the Tuzari Wilds rests the heart of the jungle’s corruption. Ages ago, the old empires sacrificed one hundred holy martyrs to forge a colossal blade called the Demonbrand. With it, they impaled the demon lord Baphumos, trapping his body and hunger in stone. Now the Prophet Ez’rath leads the Urrak into the ruins, offering blood and prayer to awaken the demon once more.
name: The Heart of Tuzari

description: Under the cold light of the moon, the dunes of the Empyrean Sands shift and whisper. From beneath their surface, the Sin-Magir rises once more, the Augur of the Stars reborn in deathless form. His followers gather beneath the constellations, drawn to a celestial relic capable of restoring their ancient empire.
name: Empyrean Sands

description: To the frozen south, high atop the Ael'deth Mountain, lies the hidden prison of Al’zerac, an ancient frost wyrm. For centuries, the Eldrin have guarded the vault, but time wears down both vigilance and faith. Cithrel now walks the outer wards, her power cracking ancient seals that once bound the Great Wyrm. When the final lock breaks, Al’zerac will rise again, not as a god to be worshiped but as a weapon to restore the Eldrin’s ancient dominion.
name: Cithrel's Fall

description: Beneath the ice-choked peaks of the Ael’deth Mountains, an ancient power stirs. Frozen halls tremble as the last egg of Al’zerac’s brood pulses with life once thought extinguished. The cruel Apostate Veras leads his cult through the shattered caverns, seeking to harness the wyrmling’s power.
name: Wyrmheart

description: In the radiant heart of Farvalaan, the Everdawn Grove blooms with golden grass and violet petals that shimmer beneath eternal sunlight. Now, shadows creep among the roots. Malgut, chieftain of the beastmen, seeks salvation for his tribe and instead finds corruption. Whispering voices promise him power, and the bloodstone crystals that grow from the soil pulse in answer. These once noble changelings call to Akari, the Dawn Lord, a great spirit who presides over Farvalaan's sunlit groves.
name: Everdawn Grove

description: A dark storm churns above the cliffs beyond Stronghold, where the arrogant orc Warlord Brogg channels thunder and fury. His raiders gather like wolves at the gate, ready to tear down the walls and claim the fort for themselves. Brogg must be made an example to prove to all other would-be bandits and raiders that the Stronghold will not be easily taken.
name: Stormwatch

description: The holy vault of Wraithtide sleeps beneath a tropical isle, its location guarded by generations of fearful villagers. Within lies the spirit of Bael’Aurum, a demon whose hunger for gold once drowned empires in ruin. The seal now weakens as undead pirates scour the island, led by the Deathless Katrine, who seeks to claim the demon’s treasure and power.
name: Wraithtide Vault

description:
Across the endless sea lies an island shaped like a wound upon the world. Its cliffs rise in a hollow ring, surrounding a chasm that descends into endless black. From within, a haunting song drifts across the waters, luring sailors to their doom.

Beneath the waves, the Sea Witch Sinthara stirs. Her voice binds the dead, her wings blot the sky, and her call grows stronger with every ship that shatters on the rocks. Soon, her song will reach beyond the horizon, calling all who sail into her grasp.
name: Sailor's Abyss

description: In the heart of the Urrak Markets, the goatmen barter lives for orcish promises of enchanted steel and dark sorcery. Beneath the noise of trade, something far grimmer moves. The orc clans prepare their captives for sacrifice, their rituals meant to rouse the demon god Baphumos from his slumber within the forsaken Demonbrand Ruins.
name: Urrak Markets

description:
Far in the frostbitten north, the port of Drakheim howls with warcries. Bleakfrost Orcs surge across its frozen shores, enslaving the weak and spilling blood in the name of their drowned god. What was once a peaceful harbor shared by eldrin and humans now serves as a sacrificial altar to the abyss.

Dark omens gather above the sea. The tide rises red with sacrifice, and the chants of the Bleakfrost echo through ruined streets. If the ritual completes, the depths will awaken, and the god beneath the waves will claim the coast in hunger and ice.
name: Ransack of Drakheim

description: The eastern road connecting the Vidahlian capital to the Stronghold falls silent as merchants vanish without trace. Wagons lie overturned and their goods rot in the rain. The search for bandits leads to the edge of the forest where a simple band of goblins seems, at first glance, to be the cause of the disappearances.
name: Silken Hollow

description: Beneath the jagged peaks of the Godfall Mountains, a hidden quarry pulses with unnatural light. The Nezari Elves have begun a relentless mining operation deep within the stone, tearing blood-red crystals from the earth in a frenzy. Their reasons remain cloaked in secrecy, but the brutality of their methods is plain to see. The Nezari prepare for war.
name: Godfall Quarry

description: Please wait until we restore your session...

The outpost of Regath festers with decay. The land it stands upon is soaked with the blood of fallen warriors; betrayed by a Heskyr acolyte, slain in a forgotten battle, for an unholy cause. Now their restless spirits are bound to the land by the unnatural magics of the lost Blood Reliquary, hidden in the crypt beneath.

Hoping to extract the blood from within, the Heskyr have mounted an offensive on the keep's inner sanctum. They have stormed the crumbling walls with ease and now seek to unleash the dormant power, awaking the anger and hate of the unquiet dead.
name: Ruins of Regath

description:
Built at the zenith of the first Heskyrian Dynasty, the Blood Monolith served as the altar of their magic, where rituals of untold power were performed that cast doom on the world and ensured the Heskyr retained their stranglehold. After the dynasty fell, its dormant magics still protected this seat of power, and to this day, no soul who entered has ever emerged.

Now the Heskry rise again and the altars of Xul are stirring within the tower where only screams escape.
name: Xul, The Blood Monolith

description:
From atop their ancient towers, the Scryers of old looked down on the little people of the world and peered into the deepest of their secrets. Through their arcane devices, they gained incredible insight for centuries, not least the location of the Blood Reliquaries, thought lost at the downfall of the first Heskyrian Dynasty, thousands of years ago.

Now the resurgent Heskyr lay siege to the ruined tower, seeking the long-lost knowledge of the Scryers; the final locations of the last remaining Blood Reliquaries that will bring about the triumphant resurgence of the Blood Order.
name: Scryer's Peak

description:
Enemies receive <bold>30% Increased Threat</> from <bold>Damage Dealers</> and <bold>Healers</>.

"The last peaceful night passed, as we awoke to a world of rapturous hatred."

description:

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Heroes hit by Blood Shards gain 1% Expertise for 30 seconds, stacking up to 15 times.</>
name: Blood Shards

description:
All incoming damage applies a bleed for 6% of damage taken on all heroes divided evenly. When a hero's health is above 90% the Carnage bleed is removed.

Carnage is dispellable.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Heroes heal for 10% of all damage dealt by any hero, divided evenly in the group.</>

<bold>Each time a Boss is defeated, heroes gain an additional 2.5% healing from damage dealt.</>
name: Carnage

description:
<bold>Non-boss enemies</> deal 10% more damage and have 10% more health.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>+10% Spirit</>
name: Challenge

description:
Periodically, one hero is afflicted by an icy curse. After 5 seconds the curse erupts, dealing magic damage to all heroes within the radius and rooting them for 3 seconds.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Enemies hit by Binding Ice are stunned for 2 seconds. Binding Ice deals 100% increased damage against enemies.</>
name: Binding Ice

description:
Several enemies in each dungeon are empowered, gaining +100% Health and +150% Power.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Empowered Minions award triple Kill Score, and upon defeating an Empowered Minion heroes gain +20% Haste and +20% Movement Speed for 40 seconds.</>
name: Empowered Minions

description:
As heroes kill enemies, eventually a Malevolent Shade will appear, reducing all damage taken by other nearby enemies by 50% and increasing their Haste by 20% until the shade is killed.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Heroes instantly replenish 85% Max Health and 50% Max Mana upon defeating the Malevolent Shade</>
name: Malevolent Shade

description:
Periodically, burning meteors crash down on heroes, splitting up into fragments that damage and stun on impact.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Each time a meteor strikes the ground, heroes generate 2 Spirit towards their Spirit Ability.</>
name: Meteor Rain

description:
Non-boss enemies have <bold>30% increased Maximum Health</>

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Non-boss enemies explode on death, dealing 15% of their maximum health as physical damage over 6 seconds to all other enemies and bosses in an area around them. This effect does not stack. The highest damage Stoneskin effect overwrites existing ones.</>
name: Stone Skin

description:
<bold>Bosses</> deal 5% more damage and have 10% more health.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Heroes' ability cooldowns are reduced by 10%.</>
name: Ultimatum

description: Some mobs & bosses have +1 difficulty stats until the dungeon timer runs out. <This modifier is hidden from the players>
name: Promoted Enemies

description:
The Shadow Lord has intervened, accumulating all kill score. As enemies are killed, Shadow Orbs are spawned nearby that can be collected by heroes.

Upon collecting 30x Shadow Orbs, an Emissary of the Shadow Lord will arrive to challenge you. Defeating it will reward Kill Score.

<bold>BONUS</>
Each time an Emissary of the Shadow Lord is defeated, heroes gain <bold>Shadow's Defeat</> for 60 seconds, increased all damage dealt by 20% and increasing Haste and Movement Speed by 20%.
name: Shadow Lord's Trial

description:
Ghorn the Avalanche is waiting for you somewhere in the dungeon. If you challenge him in combat and defeat him, he will assist you.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Defeat Ghorn to gain Ghorn's Boon and gain back 20 seconds to the Dungeon Timer.</>

<bold>Ghorn's Boon</>
Ghorn will join you periodically while in boss encounters and help you.
name: Ghorn the Avalanche

description:
Krumbug the Naughty is waiting for you somewhere in the dungeon. If you challenge him in combat and defeat him, you will gain access to his bag of tricks.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Defeat Krumbug to gain Krumbug's Bag of Tricks and gain back 60 seconds to the Dungeon Timer.</>

<bold>Krumbug's Bag of Tricks</>
Each time you deal damage to any enemy, you have a chance (10 PPM) to release a wind-up mouse to charge at the enemy, exploding upon arrival for damage to the target and nearby enemies.
name: Krumbug the Naughty

description:
Eira the White Witch is waiting for you somewhere in the dungeon. If you challenge her in combat and defeat her, she will assist you.

<bold>BONUS</>
<bold>Defeat Eira to gain The White Witch's Boon and gain back 90 seconds to the Dungeon Timer.</>

<bold>The White Witch's Boon</>
Eira will appear near you every 120 seconds and spawn a Winter Rune on the ground that persists for up to 30 seconds. When a player steps on the rune, they gain an absorb shield equal to 25% of their maximum health. While the shield is active, they take 50% reduced damage and are slowly healed.

Damage taken by the shield is <bold>reduced by 50%</>.
name: Eira the White Witch

description:
Elheryn, the Pathfinder, guides you through the dungeon.

By defeating all highlighted enemies you will reach the required Kill Score and be led to the boss.

<bold>BONUS</>
While in combat with enemies marked with Pathfinder's Guidance, you gain Haste.
Contender: +20% Haste
Adept: +15% Haste
Champion: +10% Haste
Paragon: +5% Haste
name: Pathfinder's Guidance

description:
Three Anomalous Orbs spawn near enemies periodically. The orbs are targetable and can be damaged.

Once spawned, the orbs cast Detonate, an interruptable cast that deals heavy damage to all players if left unchecked. The Anomalous Orbs are susceptible to all forms of Crowd Control, which will also interrupt the cast of Detonate.

Anomalous Orbs take <bold>400% increased damage</> while not actively casting Detonate.

<bold>BONUS</>
Each Anomalous Orb players destroy grants <bold>+480 Gem Power</> to the corresponding color of the Orb that was destroyed for 45 seconds.
name: Anomalous Orbs

description:
Periodically, players will charge up with red lightning for 8 seconds, after which a massive bolt strikes all players, dealing lethal damage.

For the 8 seconds that players are charged up, players are granted <bold>Storm Shield</>, reducing all damage taken by 50%. In addition, damage is split among other players near you.

<bold>BONUS</>
Players who survive the massive bolt are granted <bold>Storm's Fury</> for 20 seconds, granting <bold>+20% critical strike chance</>.
name: Storm Shield

description:
Every 30% of Kill Score, an enemy will drop a Truesight Orb. Collecting a Truesight Orb will grant Truesight, revealing the next enemy marked by the Heskyr. This enemy will deal pulsating damage until killed.

<bold>BONUS</>
When a Heskyr-marked enemy is killed, all heroes gain Might of the Heskyr, increasing their damage dealt and healing done by 20%.
name: Truesight

description:
Your <rt.absorb>Final Stratagem</> is replaced by <rt.absorb>Macabre Stratagem</>.

Upon use, <rt.absorb>Macabre Stratagem</> grants you 10 seconds of <rt.absorb>Matriarch Macabre</>.

If used while <rt.absorb>Matriarch Macabre</> is already active, its duration is extended by 10 seconds.
name: Macabre Stratagem
